subjectPolicy: verified internal subject must be svc:-prefixed and bounded; service identity provisioning remains a deployment responsibility

limits.action_url_policy: relative paths only; protocol-relative, scheme-bearing, backslash, whitespace, and control-character values are rejected
limits.expires_at: optional RFC3339 timestamp strictly in the future and no more than 365 days ahead
limits.plan_id: optional non-nil UUID; requires recipient_wallet_address=all and is resolved only against active, unexpired memberships

request.owner: recipient_wallet_address is normalized and validated by the Rust service; publisher identity never selects the owner. A plan_id selects active memberships server-side and must use recipient_wallet_address=all.
request.expiryPropagation: expires_at is preserved by the shared Rust NotificationPort, HTTP adapter, in-process legacy adapter, durable row, and realtime payload; both adapters enforce the same future/365-day bound
request.identity_policy: event_id and idempotency_key are producer-owned, stable across retries, bounded, and reject whitespace/control characters; verified internal subject must be svc:-prefixed

success.durability: one transaction inserts request idempotency, inbox receipt, and pending outbox event; concrete wallet targets materialize one in-app notification and channel job, plan targets expand bounded active memberships into deterministic per-wallet rows/jobs, while broadcast targets materialize one deterministic recipient=all row

targeting.concrete_wallet: normalized wallet is materialized as one durable in-app channel job
targeting.plan: plan_id is resolved against active, unexpired wallet_plan_assignments in one bounded read-only core query (maximum 10,000 recipients) through the explicitly configured NOTIFICATION_PLAN_DATABASE_URL, then each bounded wallet's persisted channel/quiet-hour policy is read from the notification store; without either read boundary the request fails closed. Each wallet receives a deterministic notification/job
targeting.broadcast: one deterministic recipient=all row is durable for owner replay; provider fanout remains server-side resolver work and is not caller-controlled
targeting.eventTypeTargetCompatibility: notification.send requires a concrete wallet; notification.broadcast requires recipient_wallet_address=all; a domain event may use recipient_wallet_address=all only with a server-resolved plan_id. Domain event prefixes remain publisher-owned and may use only targets authorized by their service contract.

errors.409: idempotency key or event identity reused with a different request hash

cutover.default: in-process adapter remains selected until N3 reconciliation and rollout approval

producerIdentity.retryRule: one bounded 25ms retry is attempted only for classified infrastructure failures and always reuses the source-derived event_id; validation, authorization, conflict, and other permanent failures return immediately
producerIdentity.sourceAudit: cargo xtask notification-producer-audit --strict requires every migrated producer call site to use the retrying event-id method; adapter implementations remain the direct send_with_event_id boundary
producerIdentity.cutoverGap: producer transactional outboxes, durable process-crash recovery, service identity provisioning, and remote/staging replay remain deployment gates
